name: Autosomal Dominant Distal Hereditary Motor Neuropathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Electrophysiological Diagnostic Criteria for Distal Hereditary Motor Neuropathy

criteria.description: Progressive distal muscle weakness and atrophy predominantly affecting lower limbs with minimal or no sensory involvement
Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern evident in family history
Electrophysiological evidence of motor axonal neuropathy with normal sensory nerve conduction
Identification of pathogenic variants in known associated genes (e.g., HSPB1, GARS, BSCL2)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive distal motor neuropathy with autosomal dominant family history and electrophysiological confirmation of motor axonal neuropathy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and electrophysiological criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal muscle weakness and atrophy predominantly in lower limbs
searchTerms: weakness and wasting mainly in legs
muscle loss in feet and calves

pathognomonic.symptomName: Foot drop due to distal motor neuropathy
searchTerms: difficulty lifting foot due to muscle weakness
distal motor neuropathy causing foot weakness

common.symptomName: Hand intrinsic muscle weakness and atrophy
searchTerms: weakness and wasting of hand muscles
loss of hand muscle strength and bulk

common.symptomName: Reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes in affected limbs
Mild distal sensory symptoms such as paresthesia (rarely prominent)
searchTerms: mild numbness in fingers or toes

occasional.symptomName: Muscle cramps and fasciculations in distal muscles
searchTerms: muscle cramps in hands or feet

occasional.symptomName: Mild proximal muscle weakness in advanced stages
searchTerms: slight weakness in upper arm or thigh muscles

occasional.symptomName: Mild gait disturbances due to distal weakness
searchTerms: slight trouble walking due to weakness

occasional.symptomName: Mild joint contractures in distal limbs
searchTerms: mild finger or toe joint stiffness
early joint contractures in hands or feet

rare.symptomName: Respiratory muscle involvement causing mild dyspnea
searchTerms: shortness of breath from weak breathing muscles

rare.symptomName: Mild scoliosis secondary to muscle weakness
searchTerms: mild spine curvature from muscle weakness
early scoliosis due to weak muscles

imaging: Muscle MRI may show selective distal muscle atrophy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as HSPB1, GARS, BSCL2, and others associated with distal hereditary motor neuropathy
other: Electromyography showing chronic denervation and reinnervation changes
Nerve conduction studies showing reduced motor nerve amplitudes with preserved sensory responses

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of sensory involvement in CMT2
Upper motor neuron signs present in ALS
No family history in most sporadic cases

redFlags: Rapidly progressive weakness over weeks to months
Upper motor neuron signs such as spasticity or hyperreflexia
references: Orphanet: Autosomal Dominant Distal Hereditary Motor Neuropathy - ORPHA:140465
Harding AE. Distal hereditary motor neuropathies. J Neurol Sci. 1993
Rossor AM, et al. Distal hereditary motor neuropathies: clinical and genetic features. Brain. 2012
